card.line: Shinar is the plain between the rivers, later called Babylonia, where people built the tower city of Babel and where Nimrod's kingdom began.

moments.title: Nimrod's kingdom begins
moments.text: Nimrod's kingdom began in Babylon, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar. From there he went on into Assyria and built Nineveh and other cities.

moments.title: The tower of Babel
moments.text: People settled on a plain in Shinar and built a city and a tower to make a name for themselves. The LORD confused their language and scattered them over all the earth.

moments.title: Amraphel king of Shinar
moments.text: Amraphel, king of Shinar, joined other kings who went to war against the kings of Sodom, Gomorrah, and nearby cities.

moments.title: Achan takes a cloak
moments.text: Achan saw a beautiful cloak from Shinar among the spoils of battle. He wanted it, so he took it and hid it, and this was a sin against the LORD.

moments.title: Temple items carried to Shinar
moments.text: The Lord let Nebuchadnezzar take King Jehoiakim and some articles from the house of God. Nebuchadnezzar carried them to the land of Shinar, to the treasury of his god.
